finding: The bare QA host root http://127.0.0.1:3456/ returned JSON {"error":"not found"} instead of the runtime UI.
rootCause: The Phase 5 QA server was restarted after generated runtime-ui build assets were removed, so staticRoot did not contain build/client/index.html and the bridge fell through to the JSON 404 handler.

codeCoverage: Added a runtime-host-bridge regression test proving /, /app, and /app/router/strategy serve the SPA shell when staticRoot exists.
operationalRepair: Restarted the Phase 5 QA server against the rebuilt client.

notes: The build/client directory remains a generated review artifact required by the live QA server, but it should not be committed.
